headline: Mayoral appointments of Jonathan Sullivan, Michele Ferguson, and James Tarr to city boards.
summary: Two of the appointees would serve on the Planning Board, one as a full member and one as an associate member. Each term starts once the City Council confirms the appointment.
items: Appoint Jonathan Sullivan to the Parks and Recreation Commission, term to expire June 30, 2027
Appoint Michele Ferguson as a full member of the Planning Board, term to expire March 1, 2031
Appoint James Tarr as an associate member of the Planning Board, term to expire March 1, 2027
Public comment from K.Dillon, attached to the James Tarr appointment
location: City Hall, Room 105, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA 02148
